title: Morning Prayer
content: Dear Lord, thank you for this new day. Guide my steps and thoughts. Amen.

title: Evening Prayer
content: Lord, thank you for today. Keep me safe through the night. Amen.

title: Prayer for Strength
content: Heavenly Father, grant me strength and courage to face my challenges. Amen.

title: Gratitude Prayer
content: Thank you, Lord, for all my blessings. I am grateful for your love and guidance. Amen.
